name: dash
summary: A rich terminal dashboard for pull requests, issues, and notifications.
best_for: Maintainers who live in PR, issue, and notification queues.
avoid_if: You prefer one-off commands over a persistent TUI.

name: skyline
summary: Generate a 3D model of GitHub contribution history.
best_for: Profile visualizations, demos, and community events.
avoid_if: You need an operational productivity tool.

name: markdown-preview
summary: Preview Markdown as it appears on GitHub.
best_for: README, issue template, and documentation review.
avoid_if: You need fully offline preview support.

name: graph
summary: Display a GitHub contribution graph in the terminal.
best_for: Users who want contribution history without opening a profile page.

name: gfm-preview
summary: Preview GitHub-flavored Markdown, including offline workflows.
best_for: Writers who need Markdown preview without relying on GitHub web UI.
avoid_if: You only need the simplest browser-based preview.

name: contrib
summary: Render your GitHub contribution graph in the terminal.
best_for: Users who want a lightweight profile visualization command.
avoid_if: You need repository or PR management features.

name: lazy
summary: A terminal UI for interacting with GitHub.
best_for: Users who want a compact TUI for GitHub resources.

name: eco
summary: Explore GitHub profiles and ecosystem information.
best_for: Developers exploring GitHub communities and profiles.
avoid_if: You need a narrowly focused productivity command.
